Worked example S02.
[Span arrangement] One continuous unit of eight spans, 30 + 30 + 30 + 30 + 30 + 30 + 30 + 30 m (centre-to-centre of bearings), precast girders simply supported during erection and made continuous afterwards; deck width 12.5 m.
[Section and material] Precast prestressed T girders, 5 per span; middle-girder section at midspan: depth 2 m; precast flange 1.80 m wide, 0.18 m thick over the outer 0.20 m and thickening linearly to 0.27 m at the web; web 0.20 m thick; bottom bulb 0.60 m wide with a 0.20 m vertical part and a 0.20 m high linear transition to the web; girder concrete C50. Consider the self-weight of the main girders only (no wet joints, diaphragms, pavement or barriers).
[Bearings and boundary] Abutment 0, Pier 1, Pier 2, Pier 3, Pier 6, Pier 7 and Abutment 8: PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric bearings, one under each girder end; effective plan size 300 mm x 400 mm, five internal rubber layers 8 mm thick. Pier 4 and Pier 5: plain laminated elastomeric bearings (fixed), one under each girder end; effective plan size 300 mm x 400 mm, five internal rubber layers 8 mm thick.
[Design standard] Highway Class I loading (JTG D60-2015); one-way traffic, carriageway width 11.5 m, three design lanes.

Worked example S01.
[Span arrangement] One continuous unit of six spans, 30 + 30 + 30 + 30 + 30 + 30 m (centre-to-centre of bearings), precast girders simply supported during erection and made continuous afterwards; deck width 12.5 m.
[Section and material] Precast prestressed small box girders, 4 per span; middle-girder section at midspan: depth 1.6 m; top width 2.40 m; flange 0.18 m thick at the tip, thickening by 6.3 cm over a 19.2 cm long haunch next to the web; bottom slab 1.00 m wide and 0.18 m thick; top slab 0.18 m thick; webs 0.20 m thick (measured horizontally) with outer faces inclined at 1:4; 15 cm x 7 cm chamfers at the upper corners of the cell; girder concrete C50. Consider the self-weight of the main girders only (no wet joints, diaphragms, pavement or barriers).
[Bearings and boundary] Abutment 0, Pier 1, Pier 2, Pier 4, Pier 5 and Abutment 6: PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric bearings, two under each girder end; effective plan size 300 mm x 400 mm, five internal rubber layers 8 mm thick. Pier 3: plain laminated elastomeric bearings (fixed), two under each girder end; effective plan size 300 mm x 400 mm, five internal rubber layers 8 mm thick.
[Design standard] Highway Class I loading (JTG D60-2015); one-way traffic, carriageway width 11.5 m, three design lanes.

args.summary: Built and analyzed the 20 m simply supported, four-girder C40 precast T-girder bridge. The OpenSeesPy model ran successfully; first vertical frequency is 6.358 Hz, girder self-weight reactions are 761.28 kN at each abutment, and maximum positive lane-load moment is 4144.15 kN·m.
